Documentation.short_help: SHYX Minimum OBB: Min-volume OBB, PCA OBB, or AABB of a vtkDataSet as a closed vtkPolyData box.
Documentation.long_help: Collects all points of the input vtkDataSet and builds either a CGAL approximate minimum-volume oriented bounding box (default), a PCA-style OBB (vtkOBBTree::ComputeOBB), or a world-axis AABB. Output is a closed triangle mesh. Field data includes OBB.Center, OBB.HalfLengths, OBB.Axis0..2, OBB.Volume, and OBB.IsAxisAlignedFallback. An Interactive Box (Position / Rotation / Scale) initializes to the fitted box so you can expand, move, or rotate it; switching Box Type re-fits and re-places the widget. Copy Input Points: when on (default), points are copied to a contiguous buffer (safe for all dataset types); when off, vtkPointSet inputs use their internal vtkPoints without copying.

IntVectorProperty.name: BoxType
IntVectorProperty.label: Box Type
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: Min-volume: CGAL oriented_bounding_box (approx. smallest-volume OBB; never larger than AABB). PCA: covariance / eigenvector heuristic (can be larger than AABB). AABB: axis-aligned box from point bounds (world X/Y/Z). All modes initialize the interactive box to the fitted size.

IntVectorProperty.name: CopyInputPoints
IntVectorProperty.label: Copy Input Points
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: When on (default), copy all input points into a contiguous vtkPoints buffer before computing the box. When off, vtkPolyData / vtkPointSet use GetPoints() directly (no copy; do not modify point coordinates elsewhere while the filter runs).

DoubleVectorProperty.name: Position
DoubleVectorProperty.label: Translate
DoubleVectorProperty.Documentation: World translation applied after RotateZ, RotateX, RotateY and Scale about the OBB center from field data (same convention as ParaView Interactive Box).

DoubleVectorProperty.name: Rotation
DoubleVectorProperty.label: Rotate (Degrees)
DoubleVectorProperty.Documentation: Degrees about the OBB center: RotateZ (Z), then RotateX (X), then RotateY (Y), matching ParaView Interactive Box (pqBoxPropertyWidget).

DoubleVectorProperty.name: Scale
DoubleVectorProperty.label: Scale
DoubleVectorProperty.Documentation: World edge lengths of the box for a 0..1 reference range on each axis (same as Interactive Box). The filter maps these onto the raw OBB mesh using the fitted half-lengths. The XML default (1,1,1) with zero Position/Rotation is treated as not yet initialized so the first pipeline update matches the raw OBB mesh; the custom box widget then sets Scale to 2*h.

IntVectorProperty.name: UseReferenceBounds
IntVectorProperty.label: Use Reference Bounds
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: Internal: Interactive Box uses explicit reference bounds (unit box when OBB field data exists).

DoubleVectorProperty.name: ReferenceBounds
DoubleVectorProperty.label: Reference Bounds
DoubleVectorProperty.Documentation: Internal: unit box (0..1) when fitted OBB field data exists; otherwise axis-aligned bounds of the OBB mesh for placement.
